OpenJPEG 2.5.3 (uclouvain/openjpeg), BSD-2-Clause, the libopenjp2 sources unchanged except that
opj_config.h / opj_config_private.h are fixed files (no threads, little endian) the JPIP index managers, and the test, benchmark and LUT
generator programs are left out. Used for the JPEG 2000 pictures of the FengYun-4 LRIT / HRIT downlinks and their test signals.
See LICENSE and AUTHORS.md. Entry in THIRD_PARTY.md.
